question: Children on antibiotics got diarrhoea 19% of the time without probiotics, 8% with them. How many must take probiotics to spare one case?
answer: About 9 children take probiotics for one to be spared
move: Ask how many people must take something for one to benefit.
ask: For the things I take to prevent illness, how many people like me does it take to help one?
trap: Thinking every child who took them was spared diarrhoea.
hint: Find how many cases 100 children avoid, then divide.
steps: About 9 children take probiotics for one to be spared
reference: Guo Q, Goldenberg JZ, Humphrey C, El Dib R, Johnston BC, Probiotics for the prevention of pediatric antibiotic-associated diarrhea, Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 2019
